model.inputs: 39 photo summaries of the niho-6 26 features (photo_features), standardized on the training photos, clipped to ±3
model.outputs: ln kH, sH-m, alphaH, ln kS, sS-q, alphaS clamped to fixed ranges
model.targets: per-photo fit on the photo's own single H / S items with prior weight 0.02
model.ridge: per output, lambda from [0.1, 0.3, 1.0, 3.0, 10.0, 30.0, 100.0] by inner capture-date CV d[i::4]
model.endToEnd: bias shift and gain per output (12 parameters), same surrogate loss as B, every H/S item of the training photos

folds.rule: sorted capture dates d, fold k holds d[k::5]

protocol.baseline: niho-10 (in-sample: its response was trained on these teachers)
protocol.settings: new niho-10 edit; presets through xmp::apply_preset at amount 1

niho6CrossValidation.source: niho-6 final response retrained per capture-date fold (NIHO6.md R23/R24, LEGACY_SHARE 0.5), same folds, 2048px render, colorcheck 1500/blur 2/flat

adoption.rule: fixed before the C folds: out-of-fold preset mean and p99>8 count below niho-6's capture-date CV, and the dark and bright-iPhone preset p99>8 counts below niho-6's CV in the same subsets

presetContextDiagnostic.meaning: surrogate, presets: 'single' = each photo's single-operation targets applied to its presets; 'oracle' = per-photo constants fitted on the photo's own 3 presets (in-sample upper bound)
